# Crosspost

> Crosspost watches a tweet.app account and reposts new posts to X, automatically or after a quick review, using each person's own X developer keys.

Crosspost is an independent service and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by X Corp. or Operation Bluebird, Inc. Using it requires your own X developer account and your own tweet.app account.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Crosspost does, current service status, and sign in or register.
- [Setup guide](/docs/setup): Connect tweet.app, choose the account to watch, add X keys, pick behaviour.
- [Posting](/docs/posting): Automatic vs review-first, replies, quotes, long posts, waiting queue and history.
- [Tokens and keys](/docs/tokens): The four OAuth 1.0a X values, the tweet.app access token, and how both are stored.
- [Troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting): Fixes for 401 errors, rejected keys, missing posts, rate limits and sign-in problems.
- [Security](/docs/security): Where keys and tokens are stored, how they are encrypted, who can use them, and how to delete them.

- [Changelog](/changelog): Dated update history with notes on what changed and why.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): The terms that apply to using Crosspost.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): What data is stored, how it is protected, and how to remove it.
- [Licenses](/licenses): Credits and licenses for the open source software behind Crosspost.
